impossible.arbitrary_permutation: IMPOSSIBLE in place without visited bitmap: gather/scatter with arbitrary index destroys unread elements; needs 2nd buffer or bitset + cycle walk (extra O(N) bits).
impossible.dependent_reduction: IMPOSSIBLE when output[i] depends on input[j], j>i (sort, reverse, suffix ops): write frontier overtakes unread state; algorithm assert w<r would fire.
impossible.sorted_run_compact: POSSIBLE: forward r>=w invariant holds; keys in place + counts to reused 2nd workspace (zero alloc across levels).
